description: Lists deterministic Gen1-to-Gen2 readiness verdicts and their reason codes.

reasons.message: The dataflow has more load-enabled queries than Dataflows Gen2 supports (50).

notes: The endpoint assesses every Gen1 dataflow in the workspace; individual selection, server-side filtering, and sorting are unsupported. ReadyToMigrate omits reasons; Unknown always includes reasons.

query_examples.description: Find dataflows needing investigation or changes.
